item.title: 'Truly unique': Dolly Parton, music star, actor and beloved figure who spanned generations
item.description: Dolly Parton, the country music icon whose soaring vibrato vocals, poignant songwriting and sparkling costumes defined her rise from a log cabin in the Tennessee mountains to the height of stardom and acclaim, has died in Nashville.
